debugData.name: Showcase alpine slope
debugData.description: terrainShowcase's alpine block (p310 §3.4): the terrain add-on's export (devTools/blender/buildShowcaseBlocks.py), 64 m / 129, a ridge rising toward +x to 22 m with a north-facing rock band 8 m high and a flat south part with a shallow pond bowl, painted in two splat maps (showcaseAlpine_splat0, _splat1; no vertex colour or AO), drawn by terrainAlpine; boulders with colliders scattered in Blender over the scree (its imported scatter) and two ice cracks on the pond (its decal set).
